_description: Trailing grid: re-centers upward when price rises above grid_upper (trail_mode=bull). Does NOT re-center downward — if price falls below grid_lower the grid stops with a limited loss. Backtested on three regimes at ±15%/30 levels: +5.0%/90d lateral 2026 (100% time in grid, 1 re-center), +3.7% bull run 2024 (+3.6 points vs static +0.1%, 3 re-centers at $76K/$87K/$101K), -3.3% bear 2022 (identical to static — stopped at exit_low). Suited for bull or uncertain market with expected further upside. Recalibrate grid_lower/grid_upper to ±15% of current BTC price. Capital = grid_levels × grid_order_size_usdt.

_backtest.lateral_2026: +5.0% / 90d (+20% ann) — 100% time in grid — 1 re-center at $81,715
_backtest.bear_2022: -3.3% — 0 re-centers — identical to static (stopped at exit_low after 9%)
_backtest.key_insight: trailing upward captures oscillations at each price level throughout the bull run (134 cycles vs 5 static)
_backtest.comparison: bull run: static +$2 / trailing +$55 — 26x more profit
